protocol.training_only: Scaler and RFE fit only each outer-training partition; no fitted fixed-split preprocessing/models reused. No hyperparameter or threshold tuning.
protocol.feature_map: V11-A: ZZFeatureMap linear reps2; V11-B: ZFeatureMap reps2 without entanglement argument
protocol.loss: cross_entropy, installed base-2 logarithm and clipping 1e-10
protocol.initialization: Explicit uniform [0,1) vectors recovered from verified full-grid manifests; fresh independent models/optimizers/samplers per fold and seed; no warm starts
protocol.ranking: Candidates frozen by user after three-seed mean full-grid accuracy; Two highest three-seed mean accuracy configurations from the completed eleven-qubit cap-400 grid. No tie-break needed for these two ranks. No best-seed selection.
protocol.aggregation: Save every seed; complete candidate/fold requires all three valid outcomes. Equal-weight seed/fold means separate from per-repeat pooled OOF metrics; do not count repeated patient predictions as independent patients.
protocol.termination: Retain valid budget-exhausted outcomes; distinguish optimizer convergence; retain all poor outcomes.
protocol.technical_retry: One retry for technical failures only. Interrupted fits restart original vector/seeds under next attempt ID; exact optimizer restoration unsupported.
protocol.selection_history: Exploratory shortlist selected on this same dataset; shared-fold evaluation is internal repeated evaluation, not independent validation.
protocol.original_test_used_field: Worker legacy field means use of the original fixed 114-case test cohort; false here because scoring uses frozen outer held-out folds, not that fixed cohort.
